scientific_integrity: An explicit functional-equation derivation proves all-size covariance; exhaustive rational checks through 11 vertices are corroborative only. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is for uniform unlabeled ordered rooted trees, n>=3. n=2 is deterministic. Broader sampling laws are not claimed. Earlier bicolored valency enumerators may implicitly contain the identity; historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact anticorrelation of two Narayana statistics in a uniform plane tree
